ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the clock edge that sequences the bus_access process registers (bus_rsp_o, enable, fifo_clr) and is forwarded to instantiated neoTRNG and FIFO components.
ports.evidence: process(rstn_i, clk_i) with rising_edge(clk_i) and port map clk_i => neoTRNG_inst.clk_i, rnd_pool_fifo_inst.clk_i

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Drives the reset branch that sets bus_rsp_o, fifo_clr and enable to recovery values; also forwarded to instantiated neoTRNG and FIFO instances.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... assigns bus_rsp_o, fifo_clr, enable; port map rstn_i => neoTRNG_inst.rstn_i, rnd_pool_fifo_inst.rstn_i

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Carries bus transaction fields (stb,rw,addr,data,...) used throughout the process to gate read/write behavior, supply write data bits and drive response generation and FIFO read control.
role: supplies write data and address bits
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ... and assignments inside that branch; fifo.re combinational expression uses bus_req_i fields

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides bit 2 tested to choose control versus data read paths and participates in the combinational generation of fifo.re; its bit selects which bus_rsp_o.data subfields are driven.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then ... else ...; fifo.re <= '1' when ... and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies data bits that are captured on write operations to update internal control registers (enable, fifo_clr); specific indexed bits are sampled into those registers.
ports.evidence: enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c); fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) inside the write branch

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record but not referenced anywhere in this source.
ports.evidence: DECL only in the port clause

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates a valid bus transaction; it governs the bus_access branch, is forwarded into bus_rsp_o.ack and is used as a term in the fifo.re combinational expression.
role: sources ack and FIFO read condition
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ...; fifo.re conditional uses bus_req_i.stb

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Distinguishes write and read operations inside the bus_access process and contributes to the combinational fifo.re expression; it gates whether writes update internal control registers or reads produce responses.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... else ...; fifo.re uses (bus_req_i.rw = '0')

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Provides the bus response bundle (ack, err, data) which is assigned each clock from bus_req fields, FIFO signals and constants; reset assigns a termination response.
ports.evidence: Assigned inside bus_access process (reset branch and rising_edge branch) to ack, err, data; various bus_rsp_o.data bit slices assigned from enable, fifo.avail, fifo.rdata, to_unsigned(log2_fifo_size_c,...), bool_to_ulogic_f(is_simulation_c)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Registered bit set each clock to the incoming bus_req_i.stb to acknowledge the transaction.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb inside rising_edge(clk_i) branch

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Set to '0' on each transaction inside the clocked process and reported on the bus response.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' inside rising_edge(clk_i) branch

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Carries control bits, FIFO status or FIFO read data depending on bus address and fifo.avail; fields assigned from enable, constants, log2_fifo_size_c, is_simulation_c, fifo.avail and fifo.rdata.
ports.evidence: Multiple assignments inside bus_access: bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_en_c)<=enable; data slices <= to_unsigned(log2_fifo_size_c,..); <= bool_to_ulogic_f(is_simulation_c); <= fifo.avail; conditional assign of fifo.rdata or zeros

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing for the entity's sequential processes and is forwarded into each instantiated neoTRNG_cell. It sequences debias and sampling registers and appears in process sensitivity lists.
ports.evidence: port map to neoTRNG_cell instances and rising_edge(clk_i) in debiasing and sampling_control processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides the asynchronous reset condition used in sequential processes and is passed into each neoTRNG_cell instance. It forces debias and sampling registers to defined reset values in the processes' reset branches.
ports.evidence: rstn_i in process sensitivity lists and reset branches of debiasing and sampling_control; port map to neoTRNG_cell instances

ports.name: enable_i
ports.functionality: Is sampled on the clock into sample_en; that sampled value gates the sampling control (resets/counting) and is propagated into the cell enable chain. External input thus starts/stops sampling.
ports.evidence: sample_en <= enable_i inside rising_edge(clk_i) in sampling_control process

ports.name: valid_o
ports.functionality: Continuously reports the most-significant bit of sample_cnt to the outside; that bit signals when the sampled data byte is ready.
ports.evidence: valid_o <= sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left) concurrent assignment

ports.name: data_o
ports.functionality: Continuously presents the internal sample_sreg vector to external consumers; data_o is a direct drive of the sampled shift register.
ports.evidence: data_o <= sample_sreg concurrent assignment

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies rising-edge timing to the entity's clocked processes; it times sreg shifting, the two-stage synchronizer update, and the simulation inverter flip-flop when that generate is active.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in en_shift_reg, synchronizer and inverter_sim_ff processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asserts asynchronous reset when '0' in the processes; it forces sreg and sync to all-'0' in their reset branches, overriding normal clocked updates.
role: overrides sreg and sync on reset
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... branches in en_shift_reg and synchronizer processes

ports.name: en_i
ports.function: enable input controlling ring and shift-in
ports.functionality: Is sampled into the shift register on clock edges and appears in latch combinational logic; en_i='0' forces latch bits to '0', otherwise latch may follow inv_out or hold previous value.
ports.evidence: sreg <= ... & en_i in en_shift_reg; latch(i) <= '0' when (en_i = '0') else ... in generate

ports.name: en_o
ports.function: reports MSB of internal shift register
ports.functionality: Drives the output en_o from the top bit of sreg, reflecting the oldest sampled en_i after shifting; it exports that internal state to the entity boundary.
ports.evidence: en_o <= sreg(sreg'left) concurrent assignment

ports.name: rnd_o
ports.functionality: Exports sync(1) as the entity random output; sync is a two-stage register that samples a selected latch bit, so rnd_o presents the synchronized sampled value to the outside.
ports.evidence: rnd_o <= sync(1) concurrent assignment

signals.name: enable
signals.functionality: Captured on clock from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) during writes and reset to '0'; read back via a bit of bus_rsp_o.data when requested.
signals.evidence: enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in write branch; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_en_c) <= enable in read branch; reset sets enable <= '0'

signals.name: fifo_clr
signals.functionality: Captured from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) on write and reset to '0'; combined with enable to form the active clear signal for the FIFO instance.
signals.evidence: fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) in write branch; reset sets fifo_clr <= '0'; fifo.clear <= '1' when (enable = '0') or (fifo_clr = '1') else '0'

signals.name: fifo
signals.functionality: Defines a record of FIFO control, data and status fields; the individual fields are driven or consumed elsewhere in this entity.
signals.evidence: type fifo_t is record ... end record; signal fifo : fifo_t;

signals.name: fifo.we
signals.functionality: Receives the valid_o output from the neoTRNG instance as the FIFO write enable and is forwarded into the pool FIFO instance's we_i input.
signals.evidence: neoTRNG_inst port map valid_o => fifo.we; rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map we_i => fifo.we

signals.name: fifo.re
signals.functionality: Generated combinationally from bus_req_i.stb, bus_req_i.rw and bus_req_i.addr(2); this signal feeds the FIFO instance re_i input to pop data on reads.
signals.evidence: fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'; port map re_i => fifo.re

signals.name: fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinationally asserted when enable = '0' or fifo_clr = '1' and forwarded to the FIFO instance clear_i port to clear or reset FIFO content as required.
signals.evidence: fifo.clear <= '1' when (enable = '0') or (fifo_clr = '1') else '0'; port map clear_i => fifo.clear

signals.name: fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Receives 8-bit data from the neoTRNG instance's data_o output and supplies it to the pool FIFO instance's wdata_i input for enqueueing.
signals.evidence: neoTRNG_inst port map data_o => fifo.wdata; rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map wdata_i => fifo.wdata

signals.name: fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Provided by the pool FIFO instance rdata_o and sampled into bus_rsp_o.data when a data read is requested and fifo.avail indicates data present.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map rdata_o => fifo.rdata; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_data_msb_c downto ctrl_data_lsb_c) <= fifo.rdata in read branch

signals.name: fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Driven by the pool FIFO instance avail_o and used to indicate availability in bus responses and to choose between returning zeros or fifo.rdata on data reads.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map avail_o => fifo.avail; used in read branch if (fifo.avail = '0') then zero else bus_rsp_o.data <= fifo.rdata; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_avail_c) <= fifo.avail

signals.name: fifo.half
signals.functionality: Connected to the pool FIFO half_o output; declared here but not used elsewhere in this source.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map half_o => fifo.half (no other references)

signals.name: fifo.free
signals.functionality: Connected to the pool FIFO free_o output and made available internally; not consumed elsewhere in this source.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst port map free_o => fifo.free (no other references)

signals.name: cell_en_in
signals.functionality: Combinationally conveys the sampled enable to cell 0 and chains the en_o outputs of earlier cells into the en_i inputs of later cells. Each element is connected into the instantiated neoTRNG_cell en_i port.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignments cell_en_in(0) <= sample_en; cell_en_in(NUM_CELLS-1 downto 1) <= cell_en_out(NUM_CELLS-2 downto 0); and port map en_i => cell_en_in(i)

signals.name: cell_en_out
signals.functionality: Collects en_o outputs from each neoTRNG_cell instance; those bits feed the next cell_en_in slice and the MSB of cell_en_out is used in debias state update logic.
signals.evidence: port map en_o => cell_en_out(i); cell_en_in(...) <= cell_en_out(...); debias_state update uses cell_en_out(cell_en_out'left) in rising_edge branch

signals.name: cell_rnd
signals.functionality: Receives rnd_o from each instantiated neoTRNG_cell and supplies those bits into the combinational XOR reduction that produces cell_sum.
signals.evidence: port map rnd_o => cell_rnd(i); combine process loops tmp_v := tmp_v xor cell_rnd(i) and assigns cell_sum

signals.name: cell_sum
signals.functionality: Is computed combinationally by XOR-reducing all cell_rnd bits and is presented to the debias shift register as the sampled entropy input.
signals.evidence: combine process XORs cell_rnd(i) into tmp_v and assigns cell_sum; debias_sreg <= debias_sreg(0) & cell_sum in debiasing process

signals.name: debias_sreg
signals.functionality: Captures cell_sum on each rising clock into a two-bit shift register (resettable). Its bits produce debias_data and contribute to debias_valid computation.
signals.evidence: reset and rising_edge branch in debiasing: debias_sreg <= debias_sreg(0) & cell_sum; debias_data <= debias_sreg(0); debias_valid <= debias_state and (debias_sreg(1) xor debias_sreg(0))

signals.name: debias_state
signals.functionality: Is a clocked state bit toggled and ANDed with the MSB of cell_en_out on each clock; it is reset to '0' and participates in forming debias_valid.
signals.evidence: debias_state <= (not debias_state) and cell_en_out(cell_en_out'left) in rising_edge branch; debias_valid <= debias_state and (...)

signals.name: debias_valid
signals.functionality: Combinationally indicates a valid debiased sample when debias_state is set and the two-bit debias_sreg differ; it gates sampling increments and shift updates.
signals.evidence: debias_valid <= debias_state and (debias_sreg(1) xor debias_sreg(0)); used in sampling_control condition 'elsif (debias_valid = '1') then'

signals.name: debias_data
signals.functionality: Is assigned from the low bit of debias_sreg and supplies the bit that is XOR-ed into the sampling shift register on each debias_valid event.
signals.evidence: debias_data <= debias_sreg(0); sample_sreg update uses debias_data in sampling_control

signals.name: sample_en
signals.functionality: Captures enable_i on the rising clock and holds it; the held value gates sampling behavior and is forwarded to cell_en_in(0). It is reset to '0' in reset branch.
signals.evidence: sample_en <= enable_i in rising_edge branch; cell_en_in(0) <= sample_en; used in sampling_control condition 'if (sample_en = '0') or (...) then'

signals.name: sample_sreg
signals.functionality: Holds the sampled byte; on debias_valid events it shifts and inserts (sample_sreg(7) xor debias_data) at LSB, and it is resettable. It is continuously exposed on data_o.
signals.evidence: reset and rising_edge branch in sampling_control: sample_sreg <= sample_sreg(6 downto 0) & (sample_sreg(7) xor debias_data); data_o <= sample_sreg

signals.name: sample_cnt
signals.functionality: Counts debias_valid events by incrementing on each valid debiased sample; it resets when sample_en is '0' or its MSB becomes '1'. Its MSB is driven out as valid_o.
signals.evidence: sample_cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(sample_cnt) + 1) in sampling_control; valid_o <= sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left); sampling_control checks sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left) in condition

signals.name: sreg
signals.functionality: On rising clock it shifts its lower bits up and captures en_i at the LSB; it resets to zeros on rstn_i and its MSB is driven out as en_o and read by latch conditions.
signals.evidence: en_shift_reg process: reset and sreg <= sreg(sreg'left-1 downto 0) & en_i; en_o <= sreg(sreg'left); latch uses sreg(i) in conditional

signals.name: latch
signals.functionality: Driven by a conditional concurrent assignment: forced '0' if en_i='0', else holds its previous value while sreg(i)='0', otherwise follows inv_out(i); its bits feed inv_in and the synchronizer sample.
signals.evidence: latch(i) <= '0' when (en_i = '0') else latch(i) when (sreg(i) = '0') else inv_out(i); inv_in and synchronizer read latch

signals.name: inv_in
signals.functionality: Assigned from latch with a one-position rotation (inv_in(0)<=latch(NUM_INV-1), rest shifted); each inv_in(i) is the input to the corresponding inverter producing inv_out(i).
signals.evidence: inv_in(0) <= latch(NUM_INV-1); inv_in(NUM_INV-1 downto 1) <= latch(NUM_INV-2 downto 0); inv_out uses inv_in(i)

signals.name: inv_out
signals.functionality: Per index, inv_out is produced as the inversion of inv_in either combinationally (not inv_in) in non-SIM_MODE or captured by a flip-flop in SIM_MODE; inv_out then feeds latch when enabled.
signals.evidence: inverter_phy: inv_out(i) <= not inv_in(i) (non-SIM_MODE); inverter_sim_ff: rising_edge(clk_i) inv_out(i) <= not inv_in(i) (SIM_MODE)

signals.name: sync
signals.functionality: On clock edges it shifts in latch(latch'left) into sync(0) and moves sync(0) to sync(1); reset sets both bits to '0'; sync(1) is exported as rnd_o.
signals.evidence: synchronizer process: reset and sync <= sync(0) & latch(latch'left); rnd_o <= sync(1)
